Set the direction for everything we build - and start hands-on

DOVISTA is building a new digital capability. Digital Innovation & AI brings enterprise architecture, digital innovation and AI together in one department with a clear purpose: set the direction for our future IT landscape, build the shared data, AI and integration platforms our solutions stand on, and build the digital products that make it easier for dealers, partners and colleagues to work with our brands.

We are looking for a Product Leader who will own the direction of every product the department builds, and who wants to roll up their sleeves from day one. Your first assignment is to be Product Leader for the digital products we are already building, and to take on the hands-on product management work yourself. There is a lot to define: vision, mission, scope, roadmap and the dependencies between projects. You will find the right people in the business and in IT, bring them together and make sure what we build moves both our KPIs and our architecture in the right direction.

About the department

Digital Innovation & AI is part of the group function Digital Solutions and has three areas:

• Enterprise Architecture - owns the IT target architecture, architecture principles and the architecture board

• Digital Innovation - builds new digital products for customers, partners and colleagues

• AI - builds AI solutions and the shared AI capabilities other products reuse across DOVISTA

Responsibilities

Own our new digital products, hands-on

• Define and anchor vision, mission and scope across our new digital products

• Build one integrated roadmap and manage dependencies to data, product master data, ERP, CRM and integration projects

• Own backlog priorities with the delivery teams, balancing improvements in live markets with the longer-term platform

• Run discovery with sales, sales support and dealers so we solve the real problems before we build

Align people and decisions

• Identify who in the business and in IT needs to be involved, and set up the stakeholder map and governance

• Facilitate alignment on vision, scope, roadmap and trade-offs, from working level to executive management and steering groups

• Communicate progress, decisions and value clearly and honestly across brands and markets

Tie every delivery to measurable value

• Define the KPIs that show whether a solution drives efficiency or growth, e.g. automation rate, quote lead time, hit rate, cost to serve and adoption

• Establish baselines before we build and track value after we release

• Use the numbers to decide what to build next, what to scale and what to stop

Build towards the target architecture

• Work closely with our enterprise architects so every solution fits the future IT landscape and moves us towards it

• Favour reusable business services, AI agents and shared platforms over one-off solutions

• Bring the product perspective into target architecture, architecture principles and the architecture board

Lead the product portfolio

• Own direction and priorities for all products built in Digital Innovation & AI

• Set the product practices the department works by, from discovery and OKRs to value tracking

• Help shape and hire the product roles we need in other parts of the organisation, as the portfolio grows

Shape data, AI and innovation

• Turn ideas into testable hypotheses and time-boxed experiments, and scale what works

• Work with AI architects and engineers on how AI quality is measured, evaluated and improved

• Build business cases for new digital products together with business owners

Qualifications

What you bring

• Significant experience in digital product management, including owning products end to end and setting direction across several products or teams

• A track record of delivering data- and AI-driven solutions that created measurable business value

• Experience driving innovation and digitalisation in a complex organisation with many stakeholders, ideally in B2B, manufacturing or multi-brand settings

• Experience with commercial processes such as quoting, CPQ, e-commerce or sales tools is a strong advantage

• Experience working with enterprise architects and platform teams, and an understanding of why architecture matters when you want to scale

• Experience engaging and influencing executives and steering groups

Skills

• You turn ambiguity into structure: vision, scope, roadmap and clear decisions

• You are a strong facilitator who builds alignment without formal authority

• You have commercial acumen and naturally frame work in KPIs and value

• You are technically curious, with a working understanding of data platforms, integration, APIs and modern AI such as LLMs and agents

• AI is not your only hammer. You know when a problem is best solved with AI, and when it needs rules, integration, data work, process change or conventional software

• You are a clear storyteller in writing and in person, and fluent in English. A Scandinavian language is an advantage

As a person

• Hands-on and happy to get into the details, while keeping the portfolio view

• Curious, pragmatic and driven by outcomes rather than output

• Builds trust quickly across business and IT, and across cultures

• Decisive, and takes ownership of your decisions

What we offer

• A rare chance to shape a new department and its product portfolio from the start

• Products with a direct and visible link to commercial results

• A leader who expects you to challenge, decide and own the direction

• An international group of brands with the long-term perspective of a foundation-owned company

Practical information

• Location: Horsens (DOVISTA HQ)

• Working model: We support flexible ways of working, recognising that the right balance depends on the role, the team and business needs.

• Travel: Some travel across Europe should be expected.

Want to know more?

If this sounds like the kind of role you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We will be inviting for interviews shortly and will close the position once we have found the right match.

If you have any questions about the role, please contact the hiring manager Anders Butzbach Christensen, Senior Director, Digital Innovation & AI, at abut@dovista.com.

About Us

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people’s everyday lives.

Each brand has its own story, expertise, and strengths, yet all work to improve everyday living through quality solutions that meet our customers’ needs and shape homes and buildings that connect people with the world outside.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We’re looking for a Solution Architect who’s ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins.

**Solution Architect

**The Solution Architect is responsible for designing and delivering technical solutions that enable customers to successfully adopt and integrate Monta into their existing technology environments. The role spans pre-sales and post-sales, with a primary focus on solution architecture, hands-on enterprise integrations, and the design and execution of customer migration projects.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Lead technical discovery to understand customer requirements, existing systems, integration needs and migration complexity.

• Design, develop, test and implement integrations between Monta and enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, finance and data platforms.

• Design and execute customer migration projects, including technical assessments, migration planning, cutover strategies, testing and validation.

• Define scalable solution architectures, integration approaches, data flows and technical specifications.

• Support Solution Engineers and Sales during pre-sales with architecture design, integration feasibility, migration scoping and technical risk assessments.

• Collaborate with customer IT teams, Product and Engineering to troubleshoot technical issues, resolve implementation challenges and ensure successful customer onboarding.

**Core Skills And Experience

**

• Proven experience in a Solution Architect, Integration Architect or similar customer-facing technical role.

• Hands-on experience building and implementing enterprise SaaS integrations, not solely designing or overseeing them.

• Experience planning and executing complex customer migrations, including technical discovery, cutover planning, testing and issue resolution.

• Experience integrating enterprise business systems such as ERP, CRM, finance or data and analytics platforms.

• Strong customer communication, technical problem-solving and solution design skills, with professional English.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Experience

**

• Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central, Databricks, Salesforce, SAP or similar.

• Experience migrating customers between enterprise SaaS platforms, including data migration, system configuration and service continuity.

• Experience supporting both pre-sales solution design and post-sales implementation.

• Experience in EV charging, energy, mobility, IoT or similarly complex technology ecosystems.

• With experience supporting customers across Western Europe.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn’t a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_**Primary Outcome

_Design and deliver reliable enterprise integrations and successful customer migrations that accelerate onboarding, minimise disruption and enable revenue activation.

_**AI Competency

**You’ll be expected to work with AI-powered tools. Some we use:

• GitHub Copilot / Claude Code

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• Notion AI (docs, knowledge, meeting notes)

• Analytics & ML: Langfuse, PyTorch, Mastra

• AI-enhanced testing & monitoring (e.g., generative QA, Grafana ML)

We don’t expect mastery of all — but we expect comfort learning, experimenting, and adopting _AI responsibly.

_Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

**Job Description

****Join us in building a new strategic integration capability

**Are you motivated by shaping new solutions from the ground up? Do you enjoy turning complex business ambitions into secure, scalable technology?

We are establishing a new team in the Customer & Sector Integration tribe to accelerate ERP-to-Bank. The initiative will enable corporate customers to securely share ERP data with Danske Bank, creating opportunities for automated financial processes, improved customer experiences and data-driven products and advisory. You will help determine how Danske Bank connects directly with ERP platforms and through ERP data aggregators, and how ERP data can be securely acquired, governed and made available to internal consumers.

As Solution Architect and IT Solution Owner, you will set the technical direction and lead the architecture of this new solution area. You will work closely with the Product Owner, engineers, internal stakeholders and external ERP ecosystem partners.

**You will

**

• Define and drive the solution architecture for ERP-to-Bank.

• Act as IT Solution Owner for the solutions established within the domain.

• Translate business needs into secure, scalable and maintainable designs.

• Shape integrations with ERP platforms and ERP data aggregators.

• Establish architectural principles, solution boundaries and technical roadmaps.

• Guide decisions related to APIs, data, security, identity and cloud technologies.

• Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements and technology standards.

• Coordinate dependencies across business areas, tribes and external partners.

• Support engineers through technical guidance, sparring and architecture reviews.

The combined role brings responsibility for both technical direction and the lifecycle, governance and operational health of the solutions.

**About You

**

• At least five years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture or technical leadership.

• Current experience as a solution architect, technical lead or IT Solution Owner.

• Strong experience designing integration-heavy, business-critical solutions.

• Knowledge of API-based, event-driven and cloud-native architectures.

• Experience designing secure integrations with customers or external partners.

• The ability to communicate complex technical topics to both technical and business stakeholders.

• A collaborative and pragmatic approach to architecture and delivery.

Experience with banking, ERP platforms, accounting data, payments, cash management or third-party data providers would be an advantage.

**Why join?

**You will join a new team and help define the architecture, integration model and technology choices from the beginning. It is an opportunity to work at the intersection of banking, ERP ecosystems, data and modern integration technology, while turning a strategic ambition into a sustainable production capability.

The workplace can be in Lithuania or Denmark. If you are hired in Lithuania, the monthly salary range: from 5760 EUR to 8640 EUR gross (based on competencies relevant to the role).

Your title in job contract will be Software Architecture.

**Interested?

**Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please include a short motivational letter with your CV. If you have questions about the position, contact Tribe Architect Kenneth Mejnert on mejn@danskebank.dk

The conference floor is where deals start. The dinner is where trust is built. The clip is what 10,000 people see the next morning. Own all three.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

jobs.occupation: Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician - Translational and Clin Dev
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about pharmacometrics and model-informed drug development? Do you have experience with translational and clinical population PK/PD modeling and support of regulatory submissions?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. You will also be based in Hellerup. The team includes in-house pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and external consultants working remotely.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• 
Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• 
Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• 
Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• 
Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• 
Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Additional experience that would be an advantage:

• Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses

• Familiarity with LaTeX, Git and reproducible reporting workflows, or experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or automation to pharmacometric workflows

Key competencies:

• You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key

• You communicate complex quantitative findings clearly, work effectively across disciplines, and balance analytical detail with broader development objectives

• You combine a strong quantitative background with biological and clinical understanding and collaborate effectively with scientists, clinicians, regulatory colleagues, and external partners. Your ability to share knowledge and contribute to common goals will be valued among colleagues

Travel: 5-10 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark.

PanTarg

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are looking for a candidate with robust experimental experience with both in vivo xenograft studies as well as in vitro methods such as assay development, ELISA, flow cytometry and dose-response studies of drug candidates in cell culture. The selected candidate will generate data that supports our early translational activities, our non-clinical safety studies, and business decisions.

Qualifications

In vivo experience – Xenograft models

• Robust (5+ years) of hands-on experience with xenograft models of cancer, including CDX, PDX and orthotopic models.

• Strong practical experience with standard in vivo procedures, including I.V. injection via tail vein (must-have), blood collection, tissue collection, necropsy and general animal monitoring. Experience in preparing drug formulations and dosing solutions for administration, including appropriate handling and preparation of injectable drug candidates, is also required.

• Experience in the context of pharmacokinetic (PK) studies will be considered an advantage.

• Experience in planning, conducting and monitoring in vivo studies, as well as managing external CROs conducting such studies.

In vitro experience – Laboratory assays and protein characterization

• 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience, with a strong focus on assay development, optimization and protocol troubleshooting.

• Experience with relevant assays and techniques, including ELISA, flow cytometry (multicolor panels) and dose-response studies of drug candidates in standard cell culture models.

• Good understanding of antibody biology and properties, as well as protein characterization, antibody concentration determination and purity assessment using techniques such as UV-Vis spectrophotometry, SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

• Experience with additional laboratory methods and assay platforms is also relevant.

Data analysis and reporting

• Experience in analyzing, interpreting and presenting experimental data from both in vivo and in vitro studies.

• Ability to perform relevant statistical analyses, generate graphs and visualize experimental results.

• Experience in preparing clear and structured experimental reports and presenting study results and conclusions.

Other qualifications

• The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 4-5 years of experience from either pharma or biotech, or as a post doc.

• Good scientific project management and communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.

• On-site presence at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen will be required.

**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

seamless as they are ambitious and impactful.

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**R&D Quality encompasses four teams GCLP/GLP Quality, PV Quality, Audit Calibration, Quality and GCP Quality. R&D Quality has a large range of stakeholders, and we have an important role in delivering our 2030 vision to transform the future of cancer treatment.

In the role as AD GCP Inspection Office you will be driving day-to-day GCP Quality activities including audit together with a dedicated and highly skilled team. Furthermore, you will be taking up the role as GCP Inspection QA lead.

The role requires profound understanding of how the GCP requirements are applied into practice, especially with focus on the European requirements and interpretation of ICH GCP R3 and Computerized Systems in Clinical Trials.

The role includes hands on GCP Quality activities such as support to our many stakeholders as well as performing audits alone or together with own team members or with support from neighbouring teams. You become a key member of the R&D Quality leadership team that together drives people engagement, setting strategies and ensuring R&D Quality deliverables.

The role requires strong collaboration capabilities in an international setting across various QA departments as well across the company with target stakeholders such as Clinical Trial Operations, Clinical Data, Integration & Reporting, Digital Development, Medical, GDS&PV, and Regulatory Affairs.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Reporting to Director and Team Lead Inspection Office R&D Quality

• It will ensure GCP inspection readiness across cross functional clinical -study team.

• The role oversees end-of-end inspection planning and execution including logistics and stakeholder coordination.

• Lead and oversee GCP inspection readiness/preparation activities and serve as an inspection lead for regulatory health authority inspection including but not limited to US FDA, MHRA, EMA, CFDI, PMDA etc.

• Collaborate with the cross functional clinical study teams to develop and execute and integrated risk-based inspection readiness/preparation strategy ensuring consistent alignment across functions.

• Manage end to end inspection readiness/preparation activities, including development and maintenance of inspection storyboards with the SMEs, proactive identification and mitigation of the inspection related risk and planning, facilitation.

• Lead the mock inspections for high-risk trials across Genmab locations.

• During the inspection coordinate and assign inspection requests to appropriate SMEs providing oversight and appropriate SME, also guide to ensure timely and effective responses.

• Create/revise appropriate tools / SOPs for inspection readiness/preparation and management.

• Ensure Veeva records are updated for inspection records or related records.

• Demonstrate ability to solve complex problems requiring in-depth evaluation of various factors.

• Fulfill inspection commitments and respond to the inspection and carry out post inspection activities.

• Maintain a central repository of global inspection status and updates

• Meticulous attention to detail, excellent review skills and ability to independently manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Support/manage site inspection in collaboration with GCP Quality.

• Lead and facilitate post-inspection lessons learned session to trends, share best practices and drive sustainable process improvements.

**Requirements

**

• MS, or BS or similar in Natural Science

• 10+ years of experience in a GCP Quality function or similar

• Deep expertise in GCP processes and the EMA, PMDA and FDA requirements.

• Demonstrated leadership in regulatory inspections and health authority interactions.

• Considered to be a Domain Expert within GCP by peers with a strong interest and ability to educate others

• Experience as Lead Auditor within GCP is an advantage

DKK732.768,00---1.099.152,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
